meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为作品添加品牌色彩与排版风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容快速应用品牌视觉规范。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your artifacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual guidelines to your content.

howto.what: 为工件应用 Anthropic 官方品牌配色和字体：标题用 Poppins、正文用 Lora，自动回退 Arial/Georgia；非文本形状用橙、蓝、绿强调色。
howto.when: 当涉及品牌颜色、样式指南、视觉格式化或公司设计标准时触发。

say.text: 把这个演示文稿改成 Anthropic 品牌风格。
用 Poppins 和 Lora 排版这份文档。
say.note: 标题和正文应用指定字体。

say.text: 给这些形状涂上品牌强调色。

howto.what_en: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to artifacts: headings use Poppins, body uses Lora, with fallback to Arial/Georgia; non-text shapes cycle through orange, blue, green accents.
howto.when_en: Triggers when brand colors, style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

say_en.text: Restyle this presentation with Anthropic branding.
Format this document with Poppins and Lora.
say_en.note: Headings and body use specified fonts.

say_en.text: Color these shapes with brand accent colors.
